question: In a certain code language, 'DOCTOR' is written as 'SPUDPE' and 'NURSE' is written as 'FTSVO'. How will 'WOUND' be written in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

​'DOCTOR' is written as 'SPUDPE'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef85673940c174be10c1705fc495a6e92b4437df2b6bd0c042b7c4d74a663a79.png] 

And,

'NURSE' is written as 'FTSVO'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31cae7d32dc13ca43964697a3800b89e5ce3b2e493e22453f8e980a1fe1499af.png] 

Similarly,

'WOUND' will be written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa4cc8e33085bc91929673e1c2e6442dcd778aa74cba4c8e333d66b769ab157c.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
